crossRefs.note: He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel; so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among…
The king stood by the pillar, and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments…
But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you shall find him when you search after him with all your heart and…
You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
Then Yahweh may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to…
if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies, who carried them…
because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all…
You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was…
“Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.
translations.bsb: Neither before nor after Josiah was there any king like him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, according to all the Law of Moses.
translations.kjv: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
translations.asv: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to Jehovah with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
